scope: SDevice-only n23 independent boundary-measure, contact-SG, and quasi-Fermi-feedback ablation
contact_sg_ablation: same-state HFS on/off replacement on the native drain-contact cut
qf_feedback_ablation: M26 frozen direct operator contribution versus adjoint self-consistent relaxation
claim_policy: Boundary measure, direct contact SG response, and self-consistent quasi-Fermi relaxation are reported as separate causal layers.
A same-state contact-cut replacement measures only the direct SG contribution and excludes self-consistent state relaxation.
The M26 adjoint is a first-order feedback attribution and retains its measured nonlinear error envelope.
No default geometry, HFS, contact, SG, or solver setting is changed by M37.
